'''''Periploca''''' is a [[genus]] of plants in the family [[Apocynaceae]], first described for modern science by Linnaeus in 1753. It is native to [[Europe]], [[Asia]], and [[Africa]].<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=124567 Flora of China Vol. 16 Page 195 <big>杠柳属</big> gang liu shu ''Periploca'' Linnaeus, Sp. Pl. 1: 211. 1753]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Periploca Altervista Flora Italiana, genere ''Periploca''] includes photos plus European distribution maps</ref>
